about: The coordinator's course records: the full academic schedule each course follows (known to the coordinator) and, per exam, its release status (what students may see). Only facts already public in the course repositories or given by Louis go here: no scores, study history, credentials or unpublished lecture material. Edited by coordinator runs in bookkeeping pull requests; coordinator/README.md explains each field.

exam-approaching.focus: current exam coverage, stability, missing material, regressions; no major redesign before the exam

active.focus: meaningful new changes, open technical and teaching issues, readiness for upcoming material

completed.focus: light maintenance and compatibility; a deeper cross-course comparison and usability audit each quarter

archived.focus: checks only when the repository changes; essential maintenance
